segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I’m cleaning up the Northstar Packaging opp before forecast. They’re at 74 seats today, asking for 90 at go-live, which they still have as March 18.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Is this the one with the services bundle too, like data migration and two admin trainings?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, $12,400 for migration, $3,000 for training, and then software is $68,850 annual if we hold the 8% discount from the pricing sheet.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. One thing, their current agreement ends January 31 and I don’t see any notes that we’ve talked to them about carrying on yet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, okay. I’ll add that to my list. For the quote, deal desk already approved net 45 because their AP only cuts checks on the 10th and 25th.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Fine. Just make sure the billing tool has the invoice split right. They wanted 50% on signature and 50% after the import validation, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. And procurement asked for the insurance cert plus the updated data processing exhibit. Legal had no redlines on the limitation language.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Good. Are you sending the order form today?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, after I fix the seat table. The CRM has 88 users because of the old pilot list, but the spreadsheet from Megan has 90 named users and 6 admins.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Send me the PDF before it goes out, I’ll sanity check the dates and totals.
